starRule: Stars are estimated: each forge/upgrade material that the Rise monster dataset knows as a drop of the weapon's rank (or a "<monster> material(s) x pts." requirement) points to its monsters; each monster's lowest quest star of that rank comes from its Kiranico page (Village and Gathering Hub 1-3 = Low, Hub 4-7 = High, MR = Master); the weapon takes the highest of those, or the first star of the rank (Low 1, High 4, Master 1) when no monster is involved. Rank comes from rarity (1-3 Low, 4-7 High, 8-10 Master).
